rule.name: CleanupLoopStopsOnFailure
rule.message: This loop releases each element in a cleanup method without a try, so the first element whose release throws ends the loop and the remaining ones stay open (file handles, cursors, connections). Release each element in its own try/catch, collect the failures, and rethrow the first one with the others added as suppressed (try (...) around each element, or a helper that does this). An exception fits only when a failed release should abort the remaining ones.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $releases := ('close', 'destroy', 'stop', 'dispose', 'disconnect'), $cleanup := ('close', 'dispose', 'destroy', 'shutdown', 'stop', 'teardown', 'tearDown', 'disconnect', 'end', 'cleanup', 'doClose', 'doStop', 'doDestroy', 'doShutdown'), $hooks := ('javax.annotation.PreDestroy', 'jakarta.annotation.PreDestroy'), $skipped := ('java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService', 'java.lang.Thread', 'java.util.Timer'), $element := function($call, $name) { exists($call/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::CastExpression][(self::CastExpression/*[last()] | .)[self::VariableAccess][@Name = $name]]) and empty($call/*[1][some $t in $skipped satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($t)]) } return //MethodDeclaration[@Name = $cleanup or ModifierList/Annotation[some $hook in $hooks satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($hook)]] /Block//( ForeachStatement/*[last()]//MethodCall[@MethodName = $releases][empty(ArgumentList/*)][parent::ExpressionStatement] [let $loop := ancestor::ForeachStatement[1] return $element(., $loop/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name) and empty(ancestor::TryStatement intersect $loop//TryStatement) and empty(ancestor::LambdaExpression intersect $loop//LambdaExpression)] | MethodCall[@MethodName = 'forEach']/ArgumentList[count(*) = 1]/*[1][ self::MethodReference[@MethodName = $releases] or self::LambdaExpression[count(LambdaParameterList/LambdaParameter) = 1] [let $p := LambdaParameterList/LambdaParameter/VariableId/@Name return exists((*[last()][self::MethodCall] | *[last()][self::Block][count(*) = 1]/ExpressionStatement/MethodCall) [@MethodName = $releases][empty(ArgumentList/*)][$element(., $p)])]]/../.. )
